goal: Restore truthful, fast nearby-vacation availability cards with prices on the public homepage and prevent a cached catalog fallback from masquerading as availability.

intent_model.literal_request: Fix immediately the public last-minute slider state shown in the screenshot.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The slider must reliably show real cached availability and prices on every date tab, recover without user intervention, and stop repeating this regression.
likely_rejections: Only the explanatory banner changed while unpriced cards remained.
The current browser still displayed the broken state because its cache was not invalidated.
Only one date tab or viewport was tested.
The fix was built but not verified on the public site.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Proceed with the smallest causal repair and public release without reopening product decisions.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: The exact public route must visibly show verified priced offers after deployment.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The visitor sees available places for the selected near-term dates.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Compare places by real date-bound availability and total price.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open one place to recheck live availability and continue booking.

facts.claim: The reported page rendered availabilityStatus refreshing with fallbackPlaces instead of dated offers.
facts.evidence: Public screenshot and current route/component source show the catalog fallback branch.

facts.claim: The same public endpoint currently has verified cached offers, so the broken state persisted beyond backend recovery.
facts.evidence: Production API returned availabilityStatus verified with 41 deals for the tomorrow period on 2026-10-23.

assumptions.claim: A persisted browser fallback and cacheable refreshing response are the reason the stale unpriced cards remained visible.
assumptions.validation: Seed the former refreshing payload in browser storage, load the repaired candidate and verify that it is ignored and replaced by verified offers.

in_scope: Prevent refreshing catalog responses from being cached as last-known-good availability.
Never render generic catalog cards inside the availability rail.
Keep the previous verified data visible while a refresh is in progress.
Retry a cold refreshing response automatically within a bounded period.
Publish and verify desktop and mobile public behavior.
out_of_scope: Changing supplier pricing or availability data
Changing booking rules or unrelated page sections
invariants: Existing tab labels, slider controls and card layout remain unchanged.
Only supplier-backed date-bound offers may display availability and price.
Place detail continues to perform a live recheck before booking.
A temporary supplier failure never erases an already verified valid snapshot.
affected_family: Home-deals API refreshing and verified states
All supported locales and desktop/mobile viewports

requirements.statement: The availability rail renders only verified date-bound offers with real prices.
requirements.source: User screenshot and VII feedback standard

requirements.statement: A cold refresh or transient supplier failure does not expose generic catalog cards and recovers automatically.
requirements.source: User correction and cache reliability decision

requirements.statement: Existing approved slider, booking and contact behavior remains intact across the shared family.
The exact repaired release is published and verified on the public desktop and mobile site.
requirements.source: User publication authorization and account release rules

acceptance_checks.setup: Verified cached offers exist for a selected date tab.
acceptance_checks.action: Open the public homepage and select the tab.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every displayed card has selected dates, a positive price with ₪ and an available quote; no catalog-refresh banner appears.

acceptance_checks.setup: The route initially returns a refreshing state while the background refresh runs.
acceptance_checks.action: Keep the page open without clearing browser storage or pressing retry.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No generic place cards appear, the UI keeps prior verified offers or a bounded loader, and it automatically transitions to verified priced offers.

acceptance_checks.setup: A legacy refreshing payload is present in session storage.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The legacy fallback is not accepted as good data and the rail resolves to verified offers without manual storage clearing.

acceptance_checks.setup: The supplier refresh fails and no verified snapshot is available for the requested dates.
acceptance_checks.action: Open or keep the nearby-vacation rail visible.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The rail shows a localized actionable failure state without generic catalog cards, invented availability or invented prices.

acceptance_checks.action: Exercise all nearby date tabs, holiday mode, slider controls and one place link.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Tabs and slider controls work, cards retain contact and booking behavior, and the detail URL keeps dates, guests, room and source.

acceptance_checks.setup: A frozen candidate and prior production commit are recorded.
acceptance_checks.action: Publish the candidate and run the live checks.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The public site passes desktop and 390-pixel mobile checks; otherwise the prior version is available for rollback.

authorization_boundary: The user authorized the immediate repair and public deployment of this availability-slider defect; no unrelated content, configuration or external data mutation is authorized.
